name: astra-sim
description: ASTRA-sim 2.0 — system-level multi-die AI accelerator simulator
local_modifications: network_frontend/booksim2/main.cc — VeritX entry point with EmbedTM integration

extern/graph_frontend/chakra/src/converter/llm_converter.py — convert_rows() shim for newer LLMServingSim graph_generator (materializes legacy text; PP headers raise UNSUPPORTED_WORKLOAD_SEMANTIC fail-closed per program Phase 1 T2)

extern/graph_frontend/chakra/src/converter/llm_converter.py — Gate V2.1 (VeriTX): marker-aware layer resolution (_first_materialized_index/_last_materialized_index). EXPERT/PIM marker rows carry no memory fields, so the group-boundary paths (input load, last-group output store, inter-group send) now bind to the nearest MATERIALIZED layer instead of reading output_memory_loc/input_memory_loc off a marker (AttributeError).

extern/graph_frontend/chakra/src/converter/llm_converter.py — Gate V2.1 (VeriTX): repaired pim_parent_nodes.append() with no argument (a TypeError on the npu_group == 0 / first-PIM-block path). The first PIM block in group 0 legitimately has NO predecessor, so nothing is appended; a dummy parent would invent a dependency.
known_gaps: PIM (Gate V2.2): this vendored stack is VERSION-SKEWED, not PIM-incapable. The LLMServingSim producer half is present (PIMModel, PIM configs, PIM trace markers, converter.get_pim_compute_node() with tensor_channel), but the consumer half is missing: our et_def.proto has no PIM_COMP_NODE and still numbers COMP_NODE = 4 (the upstream casys-kaist fork inserts PIM_COMP_NODE = 4 and shifts COMP_NODE to 5), the vendored Chakra feeder has no tensor_channel/tensor_device support, and astra-sim/workload/Workload.cc has ZERO PIM references (no issue_mem path, no pim_enabled/pim_channel_id/pim_runtime in WorkloadLayerHandlerData). There is only ONE ASTRA source tree here: third_party/llmservingsim/astra-sim/astra-sim is a SYMLINK to third_party/astra-sim/astra-sim.

PIM port (Gate V2.2) requires the matching casys-kaist forks, which are NOT in this repository. Verified fetchable: casys-kaist/chakra HEAD 30221ab8bfd9212aa9c063cd0b14a7d0a2ea6dd7, casys-kaist/astra-sim HEAD d3469945c50410cac2e727c9ab627670c965db2a. The protobuf change is NOT local: adding PIM_COMP_NODE = 4 shifts COMP_NODE 4->5 and every subsequent enum, so generated bindings must be regenerated and all Chakra/ASTRA components rebuilt together, and old .et files cannot be assumed compatible (ET schema compatibility check required).
chakra_to_et binary must be built separately
convert_rows shim has no PP support — pp_size > 1 is refused (T1 preflight + converter raise), never converted as unpartitioned
llm_converter.py main conversion loop can walk past the end of the layer list (IndexError) when an EXPERT block is never closed with EXPERT END; it should refuse an unclosed block (Gate V2.1).
